plan.failureSummary: Cached page.ai step failed to locate 'Last Name' input field on an updated survey form variant.
observedIndicators: Failure occurred directly during deterministic replay from .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js on the first attempt (isRetryAttempt = false).
The live page screenshot shows form fields 'Your Name', 'Contact Email', and 'Occupation', whereas the cached script looked for 'Last Name *' and '[data-testid=\"input-lastname\"]'.
The overall page.ai instruction ('Fill out the all of the survey questions with fake data...') is semantically flexible and easily adaptable to the current form variant.
Application is healthy with 0 browser errors and successful navigation.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and retry test
remediationSteps.details: Clear the cached Page.AI file (tests/.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js) and re-run the test to allow autonomous discovery of the current form fields.

plan.notes: The survey app renders different form variations (this variation uses 'Your Name' instead of 'Last Name'). Clearing the cached replay instructions will allow page.ai to autonomously fill the current form fields and reach the thank you page.
